name: Quebec
short: Hydro-Québec's LogisVert program pays up to $6,700 for an eligible ENERGY STAR heat pump, $15,000 for an electric thermal storage system, and more for solar, induction ranges and roof insulation. The Québec government's Rénoclimat changed on October 1, 2026: grants of up to $7,000 for walls, $2,000 for the roof and $300 per window for a house, with a new flood protection stream. The LogisVert portal is in French only.
